summary: Implemented the window-title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title), which passes one tuple argument. rich/console.py adds set_window_title, gated only on is_terminal, returning True when the control is written and False otherwise. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch calling term.set_title(title) with the title from the second item. CHANGELOG.md gains an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (test_console.py, output check skipped on legacy consoles), test_control_title (test_control.py), and test_control_set_window_title (test_windows_renderer.py, Windows only). Nothing was run or committed, per instructions; verification was by reading only, so tests and mypy have not been executed.
